owner_constraints: Host alone owns currentRunId, didFinalizeTerminal, cancelCause, runTask, and identity cleanup.
Adapter alone owns working, snapshotSeq, lastAppliedSnapshotSeq, driver cancellation, and terminal publication gate.
Image owner owns one image execution task/token and one-shot tool-ledger claim; Host separately claims the run terminal.
Terminal commit runs only after Host claim and returns a typed result; Host performs teardown or local release. Each external completion follows durable recordRun success.
Nested queue preserves FIFO by transferring busy turn directly to the first waiter. No actor migration or new unchecked Sendable carrier.
Phase2 phoneSessionIsActive explicit controller check remains in Adapter. RunRequest and Callbacks external shape remains.
